reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Summit Roofing and Mr Nemes after my property suffered hail damage, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their service. From the start, they were incredibly quick in with insurance and helped me with the process. What really stood out to me, though, was their honesty and transparency always providing me updates and sending pictures. Unlike other companies I had spoken with, Summit Roofing didn’t try to pressure me into decisions. They were straightforward, pro

Mark and his installers did a great job installing my new roof and replacing the broken skylights. Mark was easy to work with, professional, and his clear expertise and years of experience made me feel like I was in great hands through the whole process! Highly recommend, and will be a repeat customer when the need arises!

Mark and his team did an exceptional job on our home. He communicated well, answered all our questions and provided a quality product and service.  I would highly recommend Mark for any roofing needs due to his integrity and great results.

Jeb Yarborough was my contractor from Summit roofing.He was recommended by a close friend.
He listened to-He helped me get the perfect roof for my home
And guided me thru the process
I can’t recommend him and Summit Roofing highly enough
The crew were thorough,speedy,and left my property spotless

The Summit Roofing team did an outstanding job on our home.  The initial response and quotations were done promptly with very fair pricing.  The roof installation took place over 2 days for a relatively large structure.  They obviously have a great deal of experience with residential roofs.  This contract also included new gutters, which went quite smoothly.  We are exceedingly pleased with the work that Summit did and the value delivered.

I recommend Summit Roof Service Inc to anyone needing a new roof or repairs.  They are dependable, reliable, and very professional.  Mark Scamardo, the president of the company is a joy to work with.  Would definitely use again.

Used Summit after the Memorial Day storms of 2024. Mark was great to deal with! Super easy to communicate with via phone, text and email. His crews worked on my roof, fence, gutters and more. The guys were super professional and did a great job taking extra special care to avoid damaging our expansive flowerbeds. Would recommend to anyone

Woke up around 5:30 AM to it raining inside our house! Unfortunately with the strong winds and storms 2 of our skylights had blown off. After a frantic google search I came across summit roofing and spoke to Mark at around 6. He was out at our house within the hour and had the skylights back in place quickly after. Mark was very thorough in explaining the damage to our skylights/roof and we look forward to having them replaced by him. We are just so thankful to have the house sealed up before th
Summit Roof did a great job. Mark is professional and has a positive demeanor. I had complete trust that he was going to do a good job and he did. He kept me up on what was happening.

Mark was great! He was easy to work with, responsive, professional and so helpful. He helped me understand the insurance process, which was wonderful! The work was completed on time and was well done! Highly recommended!

Mark is fantastic!  He is professional, efficient, and extremely knowledgeable.  We highly recommend him and his company to provide the very best service.  He is as honest as the day is long, and we have used his roofing services for years.
They did a great job replacing my hail damaged roof and gutters and appreciate their attention to detail, and the immaculate condition in which they left our home and yard.  Three cheers for Summit Roofing!!
Mark and his crew did a phenomenal job! Excellent work and customer service throughout the whole process

This was my second time using Summit Roof Service to replace my hail damaged roof and they provided excellent service on both occasions. My roof, fence, windows and gutters were all damaged on May 19th. Mark at Summit roof not only replaced my roof, he coordinated all other repairs as well. We even had some difficulty with my insurance company but Mark Scamardo was very professional and patient and was able to provide them will all documentation needed to finally close the claim. He kept me info

I have used Summit Roof twice for roof repairs. . They are prompt and did the work quickly and at a very fair price. I am very happy with their work and would highly recommend them. I will use them again when needed.

Summit Roofing has installed roofs on three of my homes over the last 20 years. They have also installed roofs on many of my clients homes. On one we were in a deadline for a closing that they met with time to spare!

Mark called me back within 10 minutes of me leaving a message with his receptionist about my leaky roof after heavy rainfall. He then showed up at my house for an inspection that same morning. His responsiveness and professionalism is commendable. He then proceeded to allay my fears by explaining what the issues were and was able to get his guys out complete the repairs within 4 days of me reporting the issue at the precise time and price he quoted me. Thank you, Mark and team, for an excellent

I have done business with Mark Scarmado, Owner of  Summit Roofing,  for over 20 years.  Not only has he repaired and replaced my roof multiple times but he continues to assist my clients with their roofing needs.  His crews are very efficient and very professional.  I am always thrilled to recommend Summit Roofing!

I have been using Summit Roof Service since Mark first started the business in 1993.  I may have been his first customer!  Seem to remember something about that..... He has continued to roof my properties ever since.  Always an excellent job.  Attention to detail and always provides excellent follow up service if needed - which has been rare.  I will continue to use Summit Roof Service for all my roofing needs.  No hesitation recommending.

I have used Summit Roof for three roof jobs over the last 20 years.  I have never had any issues with their service or quality of workmanship.  I have referred several friends to them, and they have all had excellent experiences also.  These days it can be difficult to find reputable companies who care about their work and can be sure their customers are treated well.  Summit Roof gets it right the first time, and I would highly recommend them for any roofing needs.

Working with Summit Roof Service was easy.   They led me through the insurance process and were helpful every step of the way.  They were punctual and patient.  They know their business and how to care for customers.  I recommend Summit Roof Services  to anyone who is in need of roof repair.  Mark Scamardo not only saw to my roofing needs but managed the window repairs as well.  First rate company!

reviews.text: Summit Roofing recently replaced my roof and I'm very, very pleased with the results. Frankie Francis guided me through the entire process and was always available to answer my questions. I also appreciate how Frankie and the Summit team went to bat for me with my insurance company, not giving up until the insurance company agreed to a full roof replacement. On the day of the replacement, the crew was professional, efficient and thoroughly cleaned up the mess when they were finished. I highly recommend Summit Roofing to anyone who needs a roof replacement.
reviews.author: Dana V

reviews.text: Summit Roofing did excellent work on my mom’s house!  Our Project Manager, James Snyder, was fantastic, and he kept us updated every step of the way and made sure everything was done right. The quality of the work and the communication were both outstanding. I’d definitely recommend Summit Roofing to anyone needing a new roof or repairs.
reviews.author: Kay E. Garza

reviews.text: I cant say thanks enough to Glenn Nellis for fighting with my insurance to get me covered. I made my first claim in 2024 and got denied. I have worked with almost all roof companies in Austin to get me a new roof but they all failed me. They all wanted me to wait for another big storm. Luckily, Glenn came to my door and offered to help me. HE DID AN AMAZING JOB!!!! They denied after I submit a claim, but Glenn helped me fight to get my roof covered. Thanks so much Glenn 👏👏👏
reviews.author: Phu D Nguyen

reviews.text: Return customer! Summit Roofing did an outstanding job on our roof replacement, again. What impressed me most was their commitment to quality and their excellent communication throughout the entire process. Dustin Audino (project manager) kept me informed every step of the way, explaining the materials and answering all my questions patiently. The craftsmanship is top-notch, and you can tell they use high-quality materials. They truly went above and beyond to ensure we were satisfied. If you're looking for a roofing company that prioritizes quality and customer service, look no further!
reviews.author: Brady Strauss

reviews.text: Darren and Trey helped me throughout the entire process of replacing our roof from wind and hail damage. I have never filed a claim before so it was great to have them on my side. They were both knowledgeable and professional and made sure I was satisfied throughout the process. Their crew was quick, professional, and timely! I would definitely recommend the Summit Roofing team and will certainly use them again in the future!
reviews.author: Kendall Lucas

reviews.text: We had Summit Roofing remove and replace our roof in Fredericksburg due to hail damage. They did an excellent job. Jordan Santa, our Summit consultant, worked with us and walked us thru every step of the process. The on-site crew leader, Chris Cotton, was very attentive to the work of his crew and making sure we were informed of progress. They brought a whole army of workers, started early and finished late, but got the job done with quality in one day.
reviews.author: Mike Foster

reviews.text: The Summit Roofing team is top-notch. Our sales rep, James Snyder, really took care of us and led us through the roof replacement process.  He answered every question we had thoroughly and honestly.  My wife and I really appreciated his transparency.  The installation crew was professional and highly experienced.  Chris Cotton led the crew and they were the textbook example of efficiency. It was a 10 out of 10 experience.
reviews.author: Chris Maldonado

reviews.text: Summit roofing did an outstanding job on my roof. From the initial inspection to the final cleanup, their team was professional, honest, and efficient. They communicated clearly throughout the entire process and delivered exactly what they promised. The quality of the workmanship is excellent, and the crew was respectful of my property the entire time. I highly recommend them to anyone needing roofing work—truly a top-notch company.
reviews.author: Nicholas June

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Summit Roofing and Mr Nemes after my property suffered hail damage, and I couldn’t be more impressed with their service. From the start, they were incredibly quick in with insurance and helped me with the process. What really stood out to me, though, was their honesty and transparency always providing me updates and sending pictures. Unlike other companies I had spoken with, Summit Roofing didn’t try to pressure me into decisions. They were straightforward, pro

Mark and his installers did a great job installing my new roof and replacing the broken skylights. Mark was easy to work with, professional, and his clear expertise and years of experience made me feel like I was in great hands through the whole process! Highly recommend, and will be a repeat customer when the need arises!

Mark and his team did an exceptional job on our home. He communicated well, answered all our questions and provided a quality product and service.  I would highly recommend Mark for any roofing needs due to his integrity and great results.

Jeb Yarborough was my contractor from Summit roofing.He was recommended by a close friend.
He listened to-He helped me get the perfect roof for my home
And guided me thru the process
I can’t recommend him and Summit Roofing highly enough
The crew were thorough,speedy,and left my property spotless

The Summit Roofing team did an outstanding job on our home.  The initial response and quotations were done promptly with very fair pricing.  The roof installation took place over 2 days for a relatively large structure.  They obviously have a great deal of experience with residential roofs.  This contract also included new gutters, which went quite smoothly.  We are exceedingly pleased with the work that Summit did and the value delivered.

I recommend Summit Roof Service Inc to anyone needing a new roof or repairs.  They are dependable, reliable, and very professional.  Mark Scamardo, the president of the company is a joy to work with.  Would definitely use again.

Used Summit after the Memorial Day storms of 2024. Mark was great to deal with! Super easy to communicate with via phone, text and email. His crews worked on my roof, fence, gutters and more. The guys were super professional and did a great job taking extra special care to avoid damaging our expansive flowerbeds. Would recommend to anyone

Woke up around 5:30 AM to it raining inside our house! Unfortunately with the strong winds and storms 2 of our skylights had blown off. After a frantic google search I came across summit roofing and spoke to Mark at around 6. He was out at our house within the hour and had the skylights back in place quickly after. Mark was very thorough in explaining the damage to our skylights/roof and we look forward to having them replaced by him. We are just so thankful to have the house sealed up before th
Summit Roof did a great job. Mark is professional and has a positive demeanor. I had complete trust that he was going to do a good job and he did. He kept me up on what was happening.

Mark was great! He was easy to work with, responsive, professional and so helpful. He helped me understand the insurance process, which was wonderful! The work was completed on time and was well done! Highly recommended!

Mark is fantastic!  He is professional, efficient, and extremely knowledgeable.  We highly recommend him and his company to provide the very best service.  He is as honest as the day is long, and we have used his roofing services for years.
They did a great job replacing my hail damaged roof and gutters and appreciate their attention to detail, and the immaculate condition in which they left our home and yard.  Three cheers for Summit Roofing!!
Mark and his crew did a phenomenal job! Excellent work and customer service throughout the whole process

This was my second time using Summit Roof Service to replace my hail damaged roof and they provided excellent service on both occasions. My roof, fence, windows and gutters were all damaged on May 19th. Mark at Summit roof not only replaced my roof, he coordinated all other repairs as well. We even had some difficulty with my insurance company but Mark Scamardo was very professional and patient and was able to provide them will all documentation needed to finally close the claim. He kept me info

I have used Summit Roof twice for roof repairs. . They are prompt and did the work quickly and at a very fair price. I am very happy with their work and would highly recommend them. I will use them again when needed.

Summit Roofing has installed roofs on three of my homes over the last 20 years. They have also installed roofs on many of my clients homes. On one we were in a deadline for a closing that they met with time to spare!

Mark called me back within 10 minutes of me leaving a message with his receptionist about my leaky roof after heavy rainfall. He then showed up at my house for an inspection that same morning. His responsiveness and professionalism is commendable. He then proceeded to allay my fears by explaining what the issues were and was able to get his guys out complete the repairs within 4 days of me reporting the issue at the precise time and price he quoted me. Thank you, Mark and team, for an excellent

I have done business with Mark Scarmado, Owner of  Summit Roofing,  for over 20 years.  Not only has he repaired and replaced my roof multiple times but he continues to assist my clients with their roofing needs.  His crews are very efficient and very professional.  I am always thrilled to recommend Summit Roofing!

I have been using Summit Roof Service since Mark first started the business in 1993.  I may have been his first customer!  Seem to remember something about that..... He has continued to roof my properties ever since.  Always an excellent job.  Attention to detail and always provides excellent follow up service if needed - which has been rare.  I will continue to use Summit Roof Service for all my roofing needs.  No hesitation recommending.

I have used Summit Roof for three roof jobs over the last 20 years.  I have never had any issues with their service or quality of workmanship.  I have referred several friends to them, and they have all had excellent experiences also.  These days it can be difficult to find reputable companies who care about their work and can be sure their customers are treated well.  Summit Roof gets it right the first time, and I would highly recommend them for any roofing needs.

Working with Summit Roof Service was easy.   They led me through the insurance process and were helpful every step of the way.  They were punctual and patient.  They know their business and how to care for customers.  I recommend Summit Roof Services  to anyone who is in need of roof repair.  Mark Scamardo not only saw to my roofing needs but managed the window repairs as well.  First rate company!

data.summary: The reviews for Summit Roofing appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high volume (610 Google reviews), specific details about employees and projects, varied writing styles, and credible customer stories (including emergency repairs and insurance battles) strongly indicate genuine customer experiences. The strategic sample containing only 5-star reviews is a potential minor flag, but the detailed, non-generic content outweighs this concern. The BBB accreditation and 'A' rating support business legitimacy.
fake_signals: Some reviews heavily emphasize fighting insurance companies, a common marketing angle

positive_evidence: Mentions of standing by work and ensuring customer satisfaction are present in reviews, though 'warranty' is not explicitly cited.

authentic_signals: Specific employee names and roles mentioned (Frankie Francis, James Snyder, Glenn Nellis, Dustin Audino, Chris Cotton, Mark Scamardo)
Varied project details (roof replacement, skylight repair, working with insurance)
Emotional authenticity in stories (e.g., frantic search for emergency repair)
Mix of customer types (return customer, first-time claimant)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google rating is very high (4.9) and BBB rating is 'A' with accreditation. No Yelp rating was found for the specific company, and the search results show other similarly named businesses. The lack of negative reviews in the sample is notable but not inherently suspicious given the high volume and positive content.
